anomalies.observed: On the AVR-ISP connector J4, pin 3 (SCK) and pin 4 (MOSI) are both attached to the same global label SCK. The MOSI pin is therefore merged with the SCK net, while the MCU MOSI/PB1 pin (U2.6/U3.6) is only on the separate PWM net.
anomalies.expected: A 6-pin AVR ISP interface to the ATtiny should keep SCK and MOSI separate: J4 pin 3 (SCK) should connect to the MCU SCK/PB2 net, and J4 pin 4 (MOSI) should connect to the MCU MOSI/PB1 net (the PWM net in this schematic).

evidence.quote: Sheet / (fan_controller.kicad_sch), tile 1: J4 AVR-ISP-6 shows pin 1 MISO -> SDA, pin 4 MOSI -> SCK, pin 3 SCK -> SCK, pin 5 RST -> RST.

anomalies.impact: An ISP programmer connected to J4 would have its MOSI and SCK lines shorted together and would not reach the MCU PB1/MOSI pin. Programming and SPI access would fail, and the MCU PWM/MOSI and SCK nets could be driven together.
